name: Toei Animation Co.,Ltd.
summary: Toei Animation Co.,Ltd. engages in the production, marketing, and licensing of animation products in Japan, rest of Asia, North America, and Europe. The company operates through three segments: Film Production and Sales Business, Copyright Business, and Product Sales Business. The company plans and produces various animated TV shows and films through various media, including TV, movie theaters, DVDs, Blu-ray discs, streaming platforms, and smartphones apps. It develops and sells character products, such as toys, games, stationery, food packages, campaigns, and clothes, as well as engages in goods sales and events business.
